controls.procedure: Execute the fixed cohort against distinct base and candidate Git worktrees and compare observed success, error and timeout accounting.
controls.expected: Base and candidate identities are distinct and all failures remain explicitly counted rather than improving percentiles silently.
controls.observed: The exact-head benchmark used distinct Git identities with 120 successes and zero errors/timeouts on both sides.
controls.reason: Distinct exact Git identities and observed failure accounting were reexecuted on the new material head.

controls.procedure: Execute implicit personal advice and beneficiary/modal sibling cases together with generic and temporal controls on the exact candidate.
controls.expected: Implicit personal advice preserves full context while generic and explicit temporal questions retain their narrower intended scopes.
controls.observed: Exact-head benchmark and Agent-first tests preserve the personal/full-context cases and the generic/today/week controls remain discriminated.
controls.reason: Implicit personal context behavior was revalidated on the new material head.

controls.procedure: Execute the productive QUESTION lifecycle through inbound persistence, provider, delivery, outbound persistence and terminal markProcessed.

controls.reason: End-to-end latency boundary was revalidated on the new material head.

controls.procedure: Cross-check the latest independent rejection_id and every declared finding_id in learning metadata against explicit passed source_audit entries in the cumulative escape ledger, then repeat the same omission attack in auditor preflight.
controls.expected: Both producer handoff and independent re-audit stop when a known rejection or declared finding is absent from the ledger.
controls.observed: Focused producer and auditor skill tests block omitted rejection and partial finding coverage; the current ledger explicitly closes the latest rejection.
controls.reason: The independent-rejection-to-ledger completeness guard is promoted as a cumulative reusable control.
